comment: the list of 2026-11-22's phase 22 (Heaven's life: 'the city of heaven should have typical ... city ambience'): Heaven's sounds on brokenspire. Heaven.City the bed of a modern city by day (traffic, voices, the city's hum: The Sound Guild's city loops), Heaven.CityNight by night (their night loops), Heaven.Crowd the voices near the square and the market (their crowd loops), Heaven.Horn a car's or a bike's horn somewhere in the streets (SoundBits' horns), Heaven.PassBy cars passing (SoundBits' traffic), Heaven.Neon the hum of a neon sign at night (Stormwave's static electricity loop).
